name: SpaceField
description: A Fable 5 autonomous overnight build — an explorable procedural space sim in Three.js + Vite. Live demo included.

paragraphs: 🤖 A Fable 5 experiment. One of a handful of silly side projects I had Fable 5 build before the model was banned — I wanted to see how good Fable really was at game design, so I gave it a concept and let it run autonomously overnight. This one it took surprisingly far. It's still a side experiment; if Fable ever comes back, or I find the free time, I may keep building on it.

Full space RPG built unattended in one overnight session: dusk-outpost planet chapter with quests/day-night/weather, live solar-system orrery, third-person ship flight + drone combat, NMS-style ship builder, full UI suite (menu/loading/settings/inventory/quest log/credits), save system, ElevenLabs music + SFX. 13/13 automated E2E, 60 fps in every state, security + adversarial bug audit clean (docs/AUDIT.md).

Built by an autonomous build → screenshot → judge → fix loop (13 dashboard iterations, 3 parallel agent waves). Three.js + Vite runtime, Blender MCP procedural assets, Fal flux/schnell textures, ElevenLabs audio.
